{{DISPLAYTITLE:Timeline of events in ''Pokémon the Series: Black & White''}}
{{spoilers}}
In {{aniseries|BW}}, [[Ash Ketchum]] travels to the distant [[Unova]] [[region]] with his partner {{AP|Pikachu}} to continue his quest to become a [[Pokémon Master]]. In this new land, he meets new {{AP|friends}} in {{an|Iris}}, an aspiring [[Type expert|Dragon Master]], and {{an|Cilan}}, a [[Pokémon Connoisseur]] and [[Gym Leader]]. Together, they travel through the region as Ash aims to collect eight [[Badge|Gym Badges]] to compete in the [[Unova League]] and Iris keeps working towards her goal of becoming a Dragon Master. Along the way, they face challenges from [[rival]]s like [[Trip]] and threats posed by the evil machinations of the [[Villainous team|villainous organizations]] [[Team Rocket]] and [[Team Plasma]].

Following their adventures in Unova, the group departs from the region and sets out to sail through the [[Decolore Islands]] on their way to the [[Kanto]] region.
